## Description

A flattened cyrtophorid ciliate (25–70 µm, usually ~45 µm) that glides over the bottom and scrapes
diatoms and bacteria with a basket of rods (cyrtos). Oval and flat, with a notch on the left
anterior edge.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 5 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [walker](../../mechanics/locomotion.md) that grazes surfaces, including the biofilm that filter feeders cannot
reach. The anterior notch is a body [notch](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md). Width (~65 % of the length) and
size estimated.

## Not implemented yet

- The cytopharyngeal basket is not a separate structure; scraping is ordinary grazing.
- *C. uncinata* is also a fish parasite; that life style is not modelled.

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares [walking](../../mechanics/locomotion.md) with *Euplotes* and *Stylonychia* and
[conjugation](../../mechanics/life-cycle-and-division.md) with the other ciliates.
